status: DERIVED EVIDENCE — not a rerun, not a correction of the sealed record
method: For every provider turn recorded in attempt-ledger.json, the retained raw response carrying the same provider response_id is located and its usage_metadata block is read verbatim. No value is computed, estimated, interpolated or carried across turns. A turn with no retained raw response is reported as UNKNOWN and contributes to no total.
defect_being_worked_around: tools/providers.py turn_record reads `usage` on the Gemini response, but the google-genai SDK exposes `usage_metadata`. Every Gemini turn therefore recorded null tokens and null provider_reported_usage in the sealed evidence. The frozen substrate is NOT modified here; this file is derived alongside it.
lane_totals_completeness: PARTIAL — these sums cover only the 20 of 26 provider turns whose raw response was retained. They are a lower bound on true lane usage, not a lane total.
cost_basis: UNKNOWN. Two independent reasons, either alone sufficient: (1) common/price-snapshot.yaml records no established input/output price for gemma-4-31b-it at freeze time; (2) 6 provider turns have unrecoverable usage. No price is inferred and no usage is estimated.
